verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for a SaaS CRM, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions any AI assistant or agent inside Capsule. The task features it does document (repeating tasks, Tracks, calendar subscriptions) are ordinary task management, not delegation to an AI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
